name: extremal_v1
objective: Within a fixed indexed Gram and degree-3 fiber, maximize the span of full uniform-tie IG regret Cg-Copt
seed_selection: Top pre-existing paired full-regret contrasts per size, distinct indexed Gram matrices; then include original 14x8 paper witness
frontier_rule: Best-first alternate high regret, low regret, and FIFO novelty, cycle high/high/low/fifo; enumerate every valid Pasch neighbor of expanded nodes
claims: Extremal discovery only; no population frequencies, no whole-fiber optimum unless all relevant move components are proved connected
